thread:
incident-bot: INCIDENT P1 — elevated 5xx + 429 spike observed in gateway-prod. Alert rule: gateway_errors_rate > 2% for 3m. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/dashboard/gateway-prod (auto-signal)

maria (oncall): I'm paged, looking now. @samir can you pull quota-service logs? :pager:

samir: on it. quick glance — lots of 429s from quota-service to clients, then downstream gateways are retrying and hitting 502/504 from model-proxy. looks like a quota config pushed ~09:12 that changed default buckets for a subset of customers.

leo: confirmed in kube events, configmap quota-config v2026.03.15-0912 deployed by ci/cd. A/B rule reduced global_quota for "misc-tenant" group to 10 (was 100). That caused high 429 surface area. Clients backoff is weak -> retry storms.

maria (oncall): ok plan: 1) rollback quota-config to v2026.03.15-0850 2) throttle client retries at gateway 3) scale quota-service 3->8 pods temporarily 4) put canary bypass for high-value tenants. I'll run rollback now.

alex: adding gateway header to instruct clients to not retry: set `Retry-After` and short-circuit retries at edge for 429s. Pushing rule to fastpath.

samir: rollback command:
```
kubectl -n infra set env configmap/quota-config VERSION=v2026.03.15-0850
kubectl rollout restart deployment/quota-service -n infra
```

leo: kicked restart, rolling pods. also patching HPA minReplicas=5 -> 8 for quota-service:
```
kubectl patch hpa quota-service -n infra --type "json" -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/minReplicas","value":8}]'
```

support-bot: Customer impact (last 10m): 14 customers with errors > 5% of requests. Top impacted: acme-co (20% of their calls failing), beta-integration, test-tenant-3. No billing alerts yet.

beth: reaching out to account teams for top 3 affected customers. drafting message: "We're investigating increased errors in our inference API — temporary degraded availability, mitigation in progress, will update in 30m." Should we send now or wait for rollback confirmation?

maria (oncall): wait 10m for rollback to take effect then update. please include mitigation steps and ETA.

samir: logs show 429 volume dropping after first pod restarts. still some 502s from model-proxy but trending down. stack traces show model-proxy connections exhausted due to retry rate.

alex: added gateway rule to limit immediate retries by clients: max retries 2, jitter enabled. Config applied.

maria (oncall): rollback complete, HPA scaled, gateway retry limit in place. metrics: 429 rate down 70%, 5xx down 60% in last 6m. keeping monitoring window open.

leo: leaving a temporary runbook note in #eng-sre: "rollback quota-config v2026.03.15-0912 -> fixed; consider adding config validation to CI to prevent lowering global_quota for groups without traffic analysis."

beth: sent customer update to top 3 accounts with current status and ETA 30m. support queue triaged.

samir: still seeing a few tail 502s for long requests, likely from queued retries. queue draining. setting circuit-breaker on model-proxy for slow-tenants.

maria (oncall): good. next steps: postmortem owner? I'll own incident and want SRE + quota-service eng to run root cause and CI guard. Action items: (1) add config linting, (2) add canary for quota changes, (3) improve gateway retry policy defaults, (4) customer-facing postmortem within 48h.

alex: +1. tagging @eng-releases for deploy process review.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: status changed -> mitigated. No active page. Timeline and incident record created: https://incidents.redwood/2405001234

maria (oncall): closing thread for now. if anything regresses ping with high priority. :white_check_mark:
